A palindrome is a sequence of characters that reads the same forwards and backwards.

Generating a specific palindrome that is at least 255 characters long requires careful consideration to ensure it maintains symmetry throughout its length, which makes it challenging to type manually without errors.

By repeating the entire structure, we can easily generate a palindrome of any desired length. To get a 255-character palindrome, simply repeat the structure twice:
